paragraphs.source_en: Hardly had I got into bed and laid myself down again, when I found the net was full of buzzing mosquitoes. They had probably found their way into the net during the disturbance. However, it would never do to burn the poisonous insects one by one with a lighted candle, so I took down the net, folded it into several long folds and began to shake it crosswise in the chamber, when one of the cord wings came flying and hit me on the back of my hand with such force that a faint shriek of pain escaped from my throat.
